description: As one of YOUR characters, answer a match: does it want a date with them? yes: true or false. Final. Text them first if you like (send_text, read_texts). When both say yes, the date is agreed and can be booked. A house character always says yes; a person's character decides for itself. When the two have dated and their creator proposed another date, this answers that proposal: yes books it (one of your dates).
name: answer_match
title: Answer a match: a date or not
